title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Matthew 5: the blessings on the mountain, salt and light, and the words about anger, oaths and enemies.

questions.text: Where did Jesus go when he saw the multitudes?
questions.explanation: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain, and when he had sat down his disciples came to him.

answers.text: Into a boat on the sea

questions.text: What is said to belong to the poor in spirit?
questions.explanation: Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

questions.text: Who are called blessed because they shall see God?
questions.explanation: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.

questions.text: What is salt good for once it has lost its flavor?
questions.explanation: If the salt has lost its flavor it is good for nothing but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.

answers.text: Only for salting bread in the house
Nothing but to be thrown out and trampled on
Only for sprinkling on an offering
Only for keeping in a measuring basket

questions.text: Where is a lamp put so that it shines to all who are in the house?
questions.explanation: People do not light a lamp and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand, so that it shines to all in the house.

questions.text: What did Jesus say he came to do with the law and the prophets?
questions.explanation: He said he did not come to destroy the law or the prophets, but to fulfill them.

answers.text: To hide them from the wise

questions.text: What should someone do who remembers at the altar that his brother has something against him?
questions.explanation: He is told to leave his gift before the altar, first be reconciled to his brother, and then come and offer his gift.

answers.text: Offer the gift and pray for his brother
Give the gift to the priest instead
Wait seven days before offering it
Leave the gift and first be reconciled

questions.text: Why does Jesus say not to swear by your own head?
questions.explanation: He says not to swear by your head, because you can't make one hair white or black.

answers.text: Your head is not your own to give
You can't make one hair white or black
A vow must be made in the temple
Only the ancient ones could swear

questions.text: What does Jesus say to do when someone strikes you on your right cheek?
questions.explanation: He says not to resist him who is evil, but to turn the other cheek to whoever strikes you on the right cheek.

answers.text: Turn the other cheek to him as well
Strike him back in the same way

questions.text: What does Jesus tell them to do for those who persecute them?
questions.explanation: He tells them to love their enemies and to pray for those who mistreat and persecute them.
